records.real_world_identity_notes: This is the Chevrolet Cruze body entry in the 2022 Brazilian Stock Car Pro Series, a category-specific race car on the common JL platform, not a road Cruze. The 2022 CBA announcement explicitly identifies separate Chevrolet Cruze, Toyota Corolla, and common Platform annexes.

records.specification_basis: The exact-year Article 13.2 table lists first through sixth forward gear ratios for the specified X-TRAC transmission. Article 13 calls the permitted paddle-shift system semiautomatic; the platform annex identifies the X-TRAC unit and electrohydraulic paddle/GCU hardware. The exact-year regulation requires the semiautomatic paddle-shift system and the common platform lists its paddle, electrovalve, accumulator, pump, wiring, and GCU parts.
